news.title: 《彩虹六号M Tactics》正式公布，系2008年《彩虹六号：拉斯维加斯2》以来首款《彩虹六号M》单人游戏。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/BPtApebuaDiotxk.png

育碧公布了 彩虹六号M Tactics，这是一款即将推出的单人回合制战术游戏，由玩家熟悉的 彩虹六号：围攻 特勤干员参演。该作在 Gamescom 开幕之夜直播活动中亮相，零售价为 49.99 美元，预计于 2027 年在 PC、PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S 平台上发售。这是该系列自 2008 年在 Xbox 360 和 PS3 平台上推出 彩虹六号：拉斯维加斯2 以来的首款单人游戏。

提到 彩虹六号：拉斯维加斯，你在 Tactics 中将扮演 Vegas 的主角 Paul "Six" Bishop，他将远距离指挥特勤干员。Tactics 将包含 15 位来自 Siege 的高人气特勤干员，包括 Sledge 和 Ash，并拥有总计 47 张手工制作的地图，以及 90 分钟的过场动画来支撑剧情叙事。故事背景设定在 Siege 第 10 年与第 11 年之间 Rainbow 小队解体期间。开发工作由育碧巴黎工作室领导，他们曾制作过同类型的战术游戏 马里奥+疯兔 王国之战 以及最近几部 幽灵行动：火线 系列作品（顺便说一句，现在正是推出 幽灵行动：火线 新作的好时机！）。育碧还表示，游戏中没有内置商店，也没有任何商业化变现手段。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/OSAxWObuaDiolvw.png
关于无疆新界（Universes Beyond）的讨论已经非常多，作为 万智牌：旅法师对决 与其他 IP 的跨界联动，许多人将这款游戏戏称为“卡牌游戏界的 堡垒之夜”。

2026 年在单个日历年内发布了七个系列，这意味着在撰写本文时，我们正处于从 乐高漫威超级英雄2 向 乐高: 霍比特人 过渡的阶段。然而，2027 年将会有所不同：威世智不仅将系列数量削减至六个（包含三个本宇宙系列和三个无疆新界系列），而且我们也不会再看到双倍分量的无疆新界系列了——真是太棒了！

以下是目前我们所了解的 万智牌：旅法师对决 2027 年系列的所有信息，以及对它们的期待。
Nauctis: The Sunken Realm
2027 年的首个系列将于 2 月初亮相，它将带我们前往 Nauctis。这个“沉没领域”的主题完全围绕着海浪之下展开，因此你可以期待看到深海人类与鱼人、龙虾人以及海豹并肩作战。
以下是威世智的剧情大纲：“随着两个交战王国之间的紧张局势升温，一群意想不到的英雄必须挺身而出——否则他们的家园将被大洋深处的深渊吞没。水下冒险正等待着玩家，玩家将面对那些居住在远离海面的恐怖生物。”
Kamigawa: Titanbreach
2026 年我们见证了两次重返标志性时空的旅程，分别是 Lorwyn 和 Strixhaven，而在 2027 年，我们将回到神河。
当 Ikoria 时空撞向神河时，这个充满赛博朋克风格的设定将发生巨大变化，从而引出一个机甲对阵怪兽的系列。
“重返神河，驾驭下一代机甲的力量，它们足以与任何泰坦巨人相抗衡。神河人需要他们能得到的所有帮助，因为 Ikoria 的巨兽可能是这个时空见过的最大威胁。”
“如果你更想成为怪物而不是与它们战斗，你也可以在城市争夺战中驾驭来自 Ikoria 的心仪生物。穿上装备，准备好大干一场，见证一场前所未有的规模宏大的战斗。”
Zhalfir
Zhalfir 听起来非常像是给资深 万智牌：旅法师对决 粉丝的一封情书，它将作为一个独立时空登场，并带回传奇的计时术士泰菲力·阿卡萨（Teferi Akosa）。
它将倾向于非洲奇幻（afrofantasy）子流派，但我们目前对其了解还不多。
“让自己沉浸在 Zhalfir 的美丽之中，并驾驭创新的新魔法形式。该时空背后的设计者们创作了一些极具震撼力的卡牌，每一张都融合了 万智牌：旅法师对决 对非洲奇幻风格的独特视觉设计。”
“由于 Zhalfir 与许多玩家珍视的 万智牌：旅法师对决 时代紧密相连，我们在系列的各个方面都向其传承致敬。这是你记忆中的 万智牌：旅法师对决，以我们当代设计理念的关怀与热爱精心打造而成。”
无疆新界 (Universes Beyond)
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/RTGbKKbuaDionAm.png
目前尚未确认 2027 年无疆新界的具体联动内容，但这并不能阻止我们对未来的可能进行推测。目前，我们已知这三个系列的预计发布日期：
除此之外，唯一的信息来自孩之宝首席执行官 Chris Cocks 在最近财报中的发言。Cocks 关注到了近期无疆新界系列的反馈，这些系列涵盖了两次中土世界之旅、同样次数的纽约市之行、所有的 最终幻想7：重生，以及即将到来的 星际迷航：纷争。
“关于明年我们将拥有的无疆新界合作伙伴，我能说的一点是，它们可能会更接近奇幻题材，”他解释道。
“而且我认为其中任何一个都不会发生在纽约市，因为我们确实从一些粉丝那里得到了这样的反馈。”
基于此，对于 万智牌：旅法师对决 来说，有很多潜在的跨界联动会非常有趣，但重新聚焦于奇幻 IP 的想法确实引人注目。
我们最近预测，它可能是从 权力的游戏 到 艾尔登法环：黑夜君临、战锤西格玛时代：风暴之地、塞尔达传说：智慧的回响、巫师4 以及其他与 MARVEL SNAP 相关的内容。但这纯属推测，我们必须等待今年晚些时候的正式公布。

news.title: 《Tides of Annihilation》预告片确认，《生化危机4：重制版 Requiem》女演员 Angela Sant'Albano 将担任 G…

others.title: Tides of Annihilation Trailer Confirms Resident Evil Requiem Actress Angela Sant'Albano as New Voice of Gwendolyn

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/cSvkjjbuaDiojku.jpg
Tides of Annihilation 已确认 生化危机4：重制版 Requiem 的女演员 Angela Sant'Albano 将担任 Gwendolyn 的新配音。
Eclipse Glow Games 在 2026 年科隆游戏展（gamescom）开幕之夜直播（ONL）上宣布了这一消息。随之发布的还有这款备受期待的亚瑟王题材动作角色扮演游戏（RPG）的新预告片，让 Tides of Annihilation 的粉丝们初次领略了 Sant'Albano 对 Gwendolyn 的全新演绎。

官方说明称：“在预告片中，心烦意乱的 Gwendolyn 在破败伦敦的灰烬中思考着她的新现实，随后在传奇王后桂妮薇儿（Guinevere）的鼓励下，她开始掌控‘迷雾（the Fog）’的力量——这是曾经只有亚瑟王才能驾驭的力量——以从彻底毁灭中拯救伦敦和世外仙境阿瓦隆（Avalon）。”“接受命运的 Gwendolyn 拿起长剑，学会了与强大的幽灵骑士并肩作战；这段新预告片展示了被 Gwendolyn 召唤出的传奇人物兰斯洛特爵士（Sir Lancelot），他以华丽的姿态消灭了敌人。”
Sant'Albano 是一位名声大噪的影星，其履历包括《不朽者》（The Nevers）和迪士尼真人版《小飞象》（Dumbo）电影，但游戏界最津津乐道的仍是她在 生化危机4：重制版 Requiem 中扮演的角色。她在 Capcom 的第九部正传作品中饰演 Grace Ashcroft，这是该系列的一个新角色，拥有颤抖的嗓音和致命的枪法。
尽管上一部 生化危机4：重制版 的一半剧情是由备受粉丝喜爱的丧尸杀手 Leon S. Kennedy 撑起的，但 Sant'Albano 成功让 Grace 脱颖而出，成为该系列又一个令人难忘的角色。现在，她正式准备为 Tides of Annihilation 做出同样的贡献。

Sant'Albano 在一份声明中表示：“我感到无比激动和荣幸，正式宣布我将接手 Tides of Annihilation 中 Gwendolyn 的角色。Gwen 是我喜爱的那种女英雄。她心怀自我怀疑，不断质疑自己是否足够优秀，但她拒绝让恐惧使自己停滞不前。她所做的一切都源于对妹妹和家园的热爱，我认为正是这一点让她的力量显得如此人性化。能够穿上她的战靴，面对超自然的半神，并指挥圆桌骑士，绝对是我的荣幸。”
Sant'Albano 正式加入另一部令玩家兴奋的游戏阵容，但对于一直关注更新的人来说，她的出演可能并不令人意外。当前任 Gwendolyn 的配音演员 Jennifer English 宣布因健康问题退出该角色时，关于谁将接替她的传闻立即开始流传。
这位 生化危机4：重制版 Requiem 的影星是粉丝中最先传出的名字之一。当一些粉丝注意到某些角色模型似乎发生了变化时，传闻愈演愈烈。
Eclipse Glow 还宣布 Tides of Annihilation 在最终发售时将支持巴西葡萄牙语。这使其支持的语言增加到 11 种，包括英语、法语、意大利语、德语、西班牙语、日语、简体中文、繁体中文、韩语、俄语。此外，科隆游戏展的参与者也被告知他们将能够体验上手试玩版。
Tides of Annihilation 目前尚未公布发售日期，但预计将登陆 PC（通过 Steam 和 Epic Games Store）、PlayStation 5 和 Xbox Series X/S。在上周的预览活动中，这款游戏的战斗系统令人印象深刻，但仍需对动作流畅度进行一些调整。在我们等待更多更新的同时，您可以查看 2026 年科隆游戏展 ONL 上宣布的所有内容。

news.title: 《Game of Thrones: War for Westeros》预告片公开，夜王坐上铁王座

others.title: Game Of Thrones: War For Westeros Will Let The White Walkers Win
Game of Thrones: War for Westeros Trailer Features The Night King on the Iron Throne

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/got-wfw-screenshot-1-gameplay-reveal-trailer-1787657714403.png
这是首次正式展示 Game of Thrones: War for Westeros 的实机演示。这款即将推出的即时战略游戏让你可以作为众多派系之一征服七大王国。
根据科隆游戏展（Gamescom）开幕之夜直播的消息，Game of Thrones: War for Westeros 将于 2027 年初发售，并在发布前进行可玩的测试。有关具体游玩时间的更多详情将于今年晚些时候公布。
今日展示的画面包括 HBO 剧集中的众多英雄，如琼恩·雪诺、詹姆·兰尼斯特、丹妮莉丝·坦格利安和夜王——预告片的结尾，夜王稳稳地坐在铁王座上。
幸运的是，你将有机会作为各种派系重写《权力的游戏》中争夺七大王国的巅峰之战，并在即时遭遇战中部署自定义单位。伴随今日发布的官方新闻稿还提到了罗柏·史塔克、泰温·兰尼斯特，以及——令人好奇的——白灵和灰风。
除了冰原狼，特定军队还能部署巨人、巨龙、大象，以及那场摧毁了半个君临城的野火。
上个月，Game of Thrones: War for Westeros 的开发商 PlaySide Studios 将游戏的发行窗口从 2026 年推迟到了 2027 年初，并解释说额外的缓冲时间“为我们提供了继续朝着目标努力所需的时间，并确保游戏达到我们预期的高质量水平”。
“我们始终坚持我们的使命，即提供一款设定在维斯特洛大陆、且符合 RTS 玩家和《权力的游戏》粉丝期望的即时战略游戏，”PlaySide 补充道。“感谢你们的耐心和持续支持。我们知道等待是漫长的，我们非常珍惜你们的支持。”

news.title: 《Tales of Demagost: Exodus》发售日公布，类《Mass Effect》RPG 将于 4 月推出

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/xzvozebuaDinAbv.jpg

在科隆游戏展（gamescom）开幕之夜直播中，开发商 Archetype Entertainment 公布了其类 Mass Effect 风格的太空冒险 RPG 的发售日期；Tales of Demagost: Exodus 将于 2027 年 4 月 7 日在 PlayStation 5、Xbox Series X|S 以及 PC（通过 Steam 和 Epic Games Store）平台同步发售。官方首播了一段全新的电影化预告片，展示了新角色以及围绕一只驾驶机甲套装的高智商章鱼展开的玩法。
Tales of Demagost: Exodus
冒险, 角色扮演
查看更多 立即下载

她的名字叫 Salt，是你将在 Tales of Demagost: Exodus 中招募的几位队员之一。她是一名“觉醒者”（Awakened），在 Tales of Demagost: Exodus 的宇宙观中，觉醒者是拥有高等智慧、能与人类交流的动物和野生生物。Salt 将担任远程狙击手，能够使用墨汁烟幕在战斗中提供掩护。预告片的情感基调较为沉重，揭示了部分剧情元素——虽然 Salt 经常让主角 Jun 感到头疼且极具对抗性，但她在情感上被保护同类和母星的使命感所驱使。
Tales of Demagost: Exodus 的主要卖点之一是将“时间膨胀”这一科学概念融入剧情并影响故事走向。作为一款正统 RPG 游戏，它包含可以改变结局的玩家选择，你将拥有一支船员队伍陪同你（扮演名为 Jun 的“旅者”）开启星际之旅，在人类被迫逃离地球后，于广袤的宇宙中寻找新家园。
资深叙事设计师兼作家 Drew Karpyshyn 担任 Tales of Demagost: Exodus 的叙事总监。如果你对他不熟悉，他曾参与过 BioWare 一些备受好评的游戏作品，担任过 星球大战：旧共和国武士™™II：西斯领主™ 的资深编剧以及 Mass Effect 的首席编剧。

Tales of Demagost: Exodus 最初在 2023 年 TGA 颁奖礼上首次亮相，并因著名演员马修·麦康纳（Matthew McConaughey）为预告片配音并出演游戏角色而成为头条新闻。今年 6 月曾发布过一段长达 20 分钟的实机演示，展示了其动作 RPG 战斗系统，其射击机制和对队友能力的指挥让人联想到 Mass Effect——它还与 BioWare 的系列作品共享着独特的科幻美学。Archetype Entertainment 自 2020 年起就在威世智（Wizards of the Coast）旗下开展工作，我们很快就能玩到他们的心血之作了。

news.title: 乡村音乐传奇多莉·帕顿逝世，享年80岁，粉丝纷纷发文致敬悼念。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/YLasPRbuaDeFwDe.jpg
乡村音乐偶像、演员兼慈善家多莉·帕顿（Dolly Parton）逝世，享年 80 岁。
她的家人于 2026 年 8 月 25 日在多莉的官方 Instagram 账号上发表声明，证实了她的死讯。
“多莉拥有像莱茵石般璀璨夺目的人生，她不仅通过永恒的音乐和多产的创作，还凭借她的智慧、温暖和善良，让我们所有人感到如家人般亲近，她将永远是世人的榜样。多莉·帕顿留下的遗产是爱、同情和韧性。在长达七十年的职业生涯中，她以音乐和让世界变得更美好的坚定承诺，激励了数代艺术家和粉丝。她的歌曲将继续引起各年龄段人群的共鸣，她的慈善工作也将产生深远的影响，”她的家人在新闻稿中表示。
多莉的直系亲属将举行一场小型私人追悼会。鼓励粉丝和朋友通过社交媒体发帖或在她的官方网站上留言来缅怀她。
多莉的家人建议粉丝不要赠送鲜花，而是向这位歌手的“想象力图书馆”（Imagination Library）进行捐赠。

news.title: 《Rainbow Six Tactics》公布：打造回合制战术体验

others.title: Ubisoft is making the first singleplayer Rainbow Six in 19 years, and it's a tactics game in the style of XCOM

content.v: Ubisoft has identified the peanut butter and jelly in its pantry, and believes they would make a mean sandwich.

Announced at today's Gamescom Opening Night Live show, Rainbow Six Tactics is an XCOM-style tactics game led by the folks behind another turn-based tactical adaptation, the Mario + Rabbids series. It's the first singleplayer Rainbow Six in 19 years and features characters from both Rainbow Six Siege and the Vegas series.

Though, Siege is really the source text: R6 Tactics' story centers around the rebuilding of Rainbow after the events of Siege Year 10 (a story that has been told mostly through seasonal lore videos), and its playable cast includes 15 operators hand-picked from the competitive FPS. A briefing shown to press ahead of ONL included Ash, Montagne, Glaz, Doc, Nook, Smoke, and Sledge. The roster is a mix of attackers and defenders from Siege, but the Tactics missions I saw were all centered on attacking fortified terrorists.

The briefing also made it clear that R6 Tactics will have no in-game store or live-service aspects—it's just a game you buy and play. Players will operate Rainbow from headquarters and deploy operators on counter-terrorism missions. Screenshots suggest there will be an element of operator development and base building similar to the XCOM series.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rBc9FfUJHMWSVA4mTTTYnh.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uPDWypyqZoiRVfGXqN3CNh.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bmnJrf7cw3A67wPcJT8J8h.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FsNScyC4siEjDonLUYeiTh.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/b58qPDCRXQoYsbGWsF4yVh.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7hKKURNadz2obKAqpQnRih.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gpaYaMZ4uYgwHfrHZ9WYDg.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uvPeZR5cGMDxXWGeQiW54g.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HgrZcPEJnpGdR6jkg8KS2j.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jiY5s4cMiZigZy5dPs9Swi.jpg

It'll also have "dozens of hand-crafted maps from around the world," not procedurally generated ones—though there will be some randomized elements like enemy and objective locations. Every mission begins with a realtime recon phase, in which drones are deployed to covertly learn the lay of the land just like in Siege. Then comes the entry phase: Players choose entry points for operators, lay down breaching charges on walls, and execute a simultaneous infiltration. From there, the action seemingly goes turn-based: The briefing mentions that XCOM-staple mechanics like cover, overwatch, and sightlines are crucial.

Operators will seemingly have unique abilities—I noticed that Glaz can take long-range shots from across the map with his sniper rifle, acing two lined-up enemies with a single shot. Nook's ability seems to help her freely move between sightlines, and it's a safe guess that Sledge can break open walls whenever he wants.

The Vegas connection, if you were wondering, comes with the campaign's main character (and new leader of Rainbow): Paul Bishop , the protagonist of both Rainbow Six Vegas games. The story is told through cutscenes between missions, and should be a gold mine for the Siege loreheads.
Rainbow Six Tactics is out in 2027.

news.title: 使命召唤21：黑色行动6: Modern Warfare 4 Beta推送计划外更新，以回应玩家反馈

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/tSLzQgbuaDbvdha.png
Infinity Ward 发布了针对 使命召唤21：黑色行动6: Modern Warfare 4 beta 的非计划更新，以快速回应玩家反馈。
尽管 Modern Warfare 4 beta 的首个测试周末即将结束，但 Infinity Ward 推出了一个非计划更新来修复重生点问题。这并不是测试期间针对重生点的最终更新，而是更大规模改进的“早期部分”，以便玩家在测试的最后时刻不会感到太痛苦。该修复已在除热点模式（Hardpoint）之外的所有模式中上线，热点模式的修复将在测试的第二个周末到来。
我们本该在今天完成更新的……
本该如此。
我们发布了正在进行的更大规模重生点改进的早期部分。
现在已在除热点模式外的所有模式中上线。
热点模式的更改将在第二个周末上线。
去打几场比赛吧。🫡
— Infinity Ward (@InfinityWard) 2026年8月25日

这可能只是第二个周末前众多修复中的一个。玩家们一直对重生点问题、击杀时间（TTK）过快等问题直言不讳。与之前的 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 游戏 Modern Warfare 2 (2022) 相比，Infinity Ward 对测试反馈的反应和接受度已经更高了。那款游戏曾因在处理让玩家不爽的问题时无视粉丝而饱受诟病。尽管它在商业上取得了巨大成功，但由于粉丝对其试图引导系列发展的方向存在分歧，它仍然是近年来最具争议的 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 游戏之一。
在最近的一次采访中，Infinity Ward 的 Joe Cecot 承认了工作室在上一部作品中的失误，并承诺玩家会看到 MW4 在处理方式上的不同。

“我认为在 MW2 中，我们的沟通确实做得不够好，”Cecot 说道。“我认为在这个项目中，我们以惊人的方式弥补了这一点。甚至我办公桌上收到要审核的内容量都变了，比如‘嘿，我们想回应这个’。然后我审核文案或亲自撰写，这是一个巨大的转变。这种状态将持续到在线支持阶段，我想你在我们的工作室领导层也能看到这一点。Mark Grigsby（Infinity Ward 联合工作室负责人）在发帖，Infinity Ward 的账号在发帖，使命召唤21：黑色行动6 的账号也在发帖，他们都在同步发帖。他们不再是彼此独立的。我认为这非常强大，让我们感觉非常好。”
Modern Warfare 4 的第二个测试周末将于太平洋时间 8 月 28 日星期五上午 10 点开始。完整游戏将于 10 月 23 日发布，战役模式的抢先体验将于 10 月 16 日开启。

news.title: 《RoboCop》剧集选定丹·史蒂文斯担任主演

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/nsqVTFbuaDbtkwa.png
据报道，亚马逊 Prime Video 的《机械战警》剧集已选定丹·史蒂文斯（Dan Stevens）担任主演。
根据 Deadline 的报道，这位曾出演《唐顿庄园》的影星已正式加盟这部尚未定名的《机械战警》重启剧集。史蒂文斯将饰演新版的人机合体警察亚历克斯·墨菲（Alex Murphy）。
据称，亚马逊 MGM 在选角初期就看中了史蒂文斯。虽然他最著名的角色是马修·克劳利，但他还出演过《贵客》、真人版《美女与野兽》、动画剧集 我们之中（国际） 等作品。最初的亚历克斯·墨菲由彼得·威勒（Peter Weller）饰演，他曾在多部《机械战警》续集和衍生作品中回归出演该角色。
这是该剧的官方剧情梗概：“一家巨型科技集团说服城市在警队中部署一名强大的机器人——一个植入了深受爱戴的殉职警官意识的机器人。”
亚马逊在 7 月正式为 Prime Video 的《机械战警》重启版开了绿灯，不过据称自公司于 2022 年收购 MGM 以来，该项目就一直处于某种开发阶段。彼得·奥科（Peter Ocko，《月球天堂》、《49 号旅店》）担任剧集负责人、编剧及执行制片人。
来自 Blumhouse Atomic Monster 的迈克尔·克里尔（Michael Clear）、罗伯·哈克特（Rob Hackett）以及《招魂》系列的温子仁（James Wan）均担任执行制片人，丹妮尔·博佐内（Danielle Bozzone）负责监督公司事务。原版《机械战警》的编剧艾德·诺麦尔（Ed Neumeier）和迈克尔·迈纳（Michael Miner）也担任执行制片人。
“保罗·范霍文在 1987 年创作的作品领先于时代几十年，它关于技术、身份以及企业究竟为谁服务的问题变得越来越紧迫，”温子仁在 7 月表示。“凭借彼得独特的视野和大胆的叙事方式，再加上艾德以及我们在亚马逊 MGM 工作室的合作伙伴，我们正致力于致敬原作的经典地位，并在这个现代技术驱动的世界中突出其相关性，同时为全球观众打造一些鲜明的新内容。”
除了上述剧情梗概和制作八集剧集的承诺外，我们目前对《机械战警》将如何为现代观众重塑这位 80 年代动作偶像知之甚少。虽然目前还没有确定的发布日期，甚至没有任何时间表，但在获批后仅一个月就选定史蒂文斯，表明目前进展迅速。

news.title: `Marvel Tokon` 开发团队坦言：PC 版首发失利后，重拾玩家信任将“极具挑战”

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/XKcScYbuaCEgeds.png
Arc System Works 已就 Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls 在 PC 平台的糟糕首发表现致歉，并承认现在要重新赢得玩家的信任将“极其困难”。
制作人山中健平在接受 VGC 采访时对这款工作室旗下的超级英雄格斗新作进行了复盘。他指出，就内容本身而言，粉丝们对 Marvel Tokon 大多给出了正面评价，但这种积极情绪并未反映在所有平台的玩家身上。
山中表示：“他们每天都在进行对战，钻研练习模式，研究新的连招，我们看到他们在社交媒体上发布这些内容。然而，遗憾的是，在游戏的 PC 版本中，许多玩家遇到了游戏内的问题，我们对给玩家群体造成的困扰深表歉意。”
Marvel Tokon 于 2026 年 8 月 6 日在 PC、PlayStation 5 和 Xbox Series X/S 平台上线，带来了组队对战玩法。虽然评测机构大多给出了高分，但 PC 玩家却纷纷在 Steam 上留下了评价。

由于玩家反映存在卡顿问题以及强制要求登录 PlayStation 账号，Arc System Works 的这款格斗新作在上线不到 24 小时内，全语言评价便跌至“褒贬不一”。首发后的周末，随着问题持续存在，负面情绪进一步蔓延。当时工作室唯一的官方回应是承诺“调查”有关“性能问题”的报告。据报道，Marvel Tokon 在 PC 上的状态非常糟糕，甚至连著名的格斗游戏社区内容创作者 Maximilian Christiansen（又名 Maximilian Dood）都在数千名直播观众面前卸载了游戏。
Arc System Works 在随后的周一迅速推送了更新，修复了玩家报告的许多性能问题。尽管 Steam 的评价有所回升，但显而易见的是，不仅是 Marvel Tokon，整个工作室都还有很长的路要走。
山中表示：“团队正在努力继续解决剩余的问题，”并提到了自 8 月初发布以来已推出的两个补丁。他还承认，让这款漫威格斗游戏达到理想状态只是这场挑战的一部分。
在被问及如何重塑信任时，他说道：“我认为这是一项极具挑战性的任务。我们真诚地希望付出全部努力，创造一个让玩家能够流畅体验这款我们倾注了大量心血的游戏的环境，我们非常有信心游戏本身会让他们感到很有趣。”
山中再次为 Marvel Tokon 在 PC 上“给玩家带来了很多麻烦”而道歉。他及其团队希望社区不仅能留下来等待后续修复，更能关注游戏本身。
他补充道：“我由衷感谢每一位在首发期间购买游戏的玩家。对于一些购买了 PC 版但遇到这些问题、无法以最佳方式体验游戏，甚至可能暂时离开或选择了退款的玩家，我为他们所经历的种种问题表达诚挚的歉意。”
“我深知重塑失去的信任绝非易事。然而，这是我们正在正面迎接的问题，我们正试图直接解决它，竭尽所能继续努力，提供一个能让玩家流畅体验游戏的坏境。”
这位 Arc System Works 的制作人继续说道：“我觉得这就是我们目前所能做的全部。”随着更多更新的发布，他说：“我们唯一能做的就是尽力而为，祈祷这份心意能传达给玩家群体。”
无论如何，Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls 才刚刚起步。DLC 内容已确认正在开发中，凤凰镭射眼（Phoenix Cyclops）已宣布将作为可玩角色在今年秋季加入阵容。本月初，数据挖掘者还发现了另外五名潜在的格斗家。

news.title: NBA 2K 欢乐竞技场227 预热与 Rockstar Games 合作的 GTA6 主题联动活动

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/VUoeHkbuaCEeaub.jpg
NBA 2K 欢乐竞技场227 正在预告与 Rockstar Games 的联动，似乎是为了宣传 GTA6。

在 NBA 2K 欢乐竞技场227 Season 1 的预告片结尾，出现了一个非常神秘的预告。镜头向下俯冲，对准一张印有棕榈树的紫色海报，这看起来与 Rockstar 为 GTA6 发布的首张艺术图极其相似。背景中可以听到海鸥鸣叫和警笛声，随后镜头转向一台街机。一台机器上印有 2K 标志，另一台则印有 Rockstar Games 标志。屏幕上可以看到采用 GTA6 字体和配色方案的“NBA 2K 欢乐竞技场227 Season 3”字样。
赛季通常持续约六周，因此我们可以预见 NBA 2K 欢乐竞技场227 Season 3 将在 11 月 GTA6 发布前后推出。目前尚不清楚这次联动具体会提供什么内容，尤其是考虑到 NBA 2K 欢乐竞技场2 是一款 E 级游戏，而 GTA series 则以其 M 级评级挑战极限。然而，这似乎是为这款无疑将成为娱乐史上最重磅发布之一的作品加大营销力度的一部分。

到目前为止，许多粉丝对 GTA6 缺乏营销感到沮丧。虽然已经发布了两支预告片和一些伴随预售的截图，但目前也就仅此而已。不过，情况将在本周晚些时候发生变化，届时 Rockstar Games 将在 Netflix 上发布该游戏的扩展预览。Take-Two Interactive 首席执行官 Strauss Zelnick 此前曾预告过 GTA6 的大规模营销活动，而与 Netflix 以及 Take-Two 旗下另一巨头系列 NBA 2K 欢乐竞技场2 合作的决定，似乎有助于强调这次发布的重要性。
也许玩家将能够穿上罪恶都市主题的装备，或者 NBA 2K 欢乐竞技场227 中会出现罪恶都市篮球场。篮球似乎是 GTA6 的一部分，正如最近该作泄露的实机演示中所揭示的那样，但目前尚不清楚该小游戏在 GTA6 中将占据多大的分量。无论如何，一切都将在未来几个月内揭晓。

news.title: The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past expansion is out next year, here's the trailer
news.summary: Geralt's last ride before Ciri picks up the torch.

content.v: CD Projekt Red showed up to close out Gamescom Opening Night Live with two big announcements: a first look at The Witcher 3's final expansion, Songs of the Past, and a surprise "Remastered" patch coming to the base game on September 29.

If you're just hearing about this now, yes, The Witcher 3 is getting a big expansion 12 years after its release, though we got no firm release date today. To hold us over, we caught a glimpse of the new region that Geralt will explore, Letten, and a weapon type new to the games: the chain whip.
I was wondering if CDPR would ever let the White Wolf wield his favorite weapon from the books. What a nice surprise.

It'd take a bigger Witcher nerd than I to glean much from the trailer story-wise, but I'm willing to bet Geralt has been contracted to kill a thorny, druidical monster. The YouTube description for the trailer says a bit more:
"This full-fledged third expansion takes the White Wolf on a new adventure to the peaceful realm of Letten, where dark secrets lurk beneath the surface."
Songs of the Past, sadly, has no imminent release date. It's out "next year," according to the trailer.

content.v: 在今天的科隆游戏展开幕夜上，《TARAE: The Unbound》正式公布。本作是一款以东方暗黑奇幻世界为背景的俯视角动作RPG，玩家将踏上神秘岛屿，在六大领域破碎的边界之间展开冒险。
游戏预告：
游戏中，玩家将扮演六名各自背负不同因果与使命的“求道者”（暂译），他们拥有截然不同的战斗风格和成长路线。玩家可以从六大独特职业中选择角色，并通过职业技能、特性、辅助技能以及装备自由组合BD，打造属于自己的战斗方式。
战斗是《TARAE: The Unbound》的核心内容。玩家可以使用大量技能与连锁攻击，在敌群中展开高速战斗，同时需要观察强大敌人的攻击模式，通过闪避、反击等方式寻找突破口。游戏还特别强调打击反馈，希望让每一次攻击都具有足够的力量感。
除了大量普通敌人外，本作还准备了强调学习和掌握机制的Boss战。面对强大的Boss，玩家需要熟悉其攻击规律，在关键时刻完成闪避与反击，并利用自身构筑寻找击败对手的方法。

剧情方面，六名求道者将踏上彼此交织的旅程，在一次次试炼中逐渐理解彼此，并最终成为真正的伙伴。游戏世界则融合了东方神话、民间传说与传统美学，打造出一个美丽却又充满黑暗与残酷气息的幻想世界。

news.title: Lego is finally fulfilling its destiny by making a city builder
news.summary: Took you long enough.

content.v: In retrospect I'm not sure why it's taken Lego so long to get here: it's made Star Wars games, Batman games... heck, it even made a Fortnite game.

But at least it's finally fulfilling its destiny. The blocks that were made for building are finally being used for a city builder. Lego Skylines was announced today at Gamescom, and yeah, it looks like the perfect fit. Have a peek at the announcement below.
Looks pretty darn sweet, and looks pretty darn big. But how big?
"In this cozy, customizable city-builder, your choices bring a living, breathing metropolis to life. Go big or obsess over the details. No instructions. Unlimited space," says Paradox Interactive.
Unlimited space? For real? That's... quite a lot of space.

"Remember hospitals to keep everyone in one piece. Wheat for the donuts. Garbage collection, sewage, and all the other things that make a city click. How it all comes together is up to you. So stick your hard hat on and greenlight your weirdest ideas," Paradox says.
Sounds good to me: it's got that Lego cuteness but also looks like it doesn't skimp on the complexity.
Interestingly, Lego Skylines is being developed by Iceflake Studios, who were brought in to take over for Colossal Order on the trouble-plagued sim Cities: Skylines 2 in late 2025.
There's no release date yet, but you can visit the Lego Skylines store page on Steam .

news.title: Path of Exile 2 is finally getting swords in December, and also the rest of the game
news.summary: Grinding Gear Games squeezes one more class in before the action RPG leaves early access and goes free-to-play

others.title: Path of Exile 2 Is Finally Getting Its Full Release, And It’ll Be Free To Play
Path of Exile 2 Release Date Sets 1.0 Launch in December 2026
Path of Exile 2 Reaches 1.0 on 11th December, Goes Free-to-Play on PS5
10.1.0 | Chorus of Sin

content.v: It's finally time for the one thing every Path of Exile 2 player has been waiting for: swords. A new class and weapon type is coming to the action RPG later this year—oh, and the full 1.0 release of the game.

On December 11, PoE 2 will leave early access behind and go full free-to-play, just like its predecessor. While developer Grinding Gear Games has several previously announced classes to get to eventually, the 1.0 release will at least include the one many players have been waiting for.

The Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 trailer doesn't actually give the man with the sword a title, but a post on the GGG forums calls him the duelist, which lines up with the class that was teased a while ago. It's possible he's gone through a few iterations over the last few years, but he's definitely using a sword for all the new skills.

Swords are a big deal in PoE 2 because weapons are class agnostic, meaning a new weapon type is like getting a big drop of new skills for everyone to play with. I'm more of a caster player, but I can't deny how good some of them look. At one point, the mysterious swordsman pulls up a cone of icicles and slams the sword down in the middle, turning the poor monsters in the middle into bloody ice cubes. That specific attack is borrowed from a campaign boss and part of me wants to use it against him to get revenge for how many times he's killed me with it.

Even though we're still a few months away from the full release, GGG has said it will kickoff a mini-league focused on tightening up the balance across its classes. That update, 0.5.5, is expected to be released within the next month.

Many players were that's when swords would finally be leaving the scabbard, but the new trailer suggests we might have to wait. GGG will have a stream to announce more details on the full release and the upcoming mini-league on Thursday. Every now and then someone posts on the PoE 2 subreddit that they found an unusable sword as a drop that clearly wasn't intended. Maybe, just maybe, swords will be useable before the full release. Fingers crossed.

news.title: Gravhounds Reveal Trailer Sends Good Boys Into A Sci-Fi Battle
news.summary: Gamescom Opening Night Live is always full of surprises, and this year, indie developer Octopus Panic made a s

content.v: Gamescom Opening Night Live is always full of surprises, and this year, indie developer Octopus Panic made a splash with a first look at its new action-builder game Gravhounds. As seen in the reveal trailer below, Gravhounds takes place in a future where interstellar exploration and colonization have become the domain of man's best friend.

Although the trailer states that the titular Gravhounds have been "bred" for this life, their humanoid appearance suggests more than a little genetic engineering was responsible for this turn of events. In fact, there's no sign of human life at all on this hostile alien world, but the Gravhounds themselves seem human enough.

The gameplay supports 1-4 players as they attempt to build up resources for a new colony while holding on to the potential promise of coming home. Upgrades appear to play a major role in the main characters' survival, especially when they get overwhelmed by alien forces that really don't want them around at all.

According to Gravhounds' Steam page , the game's early-access period will last at least six months. It will "include the core Gravhound experience," but we plan to expand its breadth, depth, and replayability on the road to 1.0," reads the statement. Both solo and co-op campaigns will be playable during this initial release.
Gravhounds' early-access release will hit Xbox Series X|S and PC on November 2. It will also be available on day one with Xbox Game Pass.

news.title: All Anyone At Gamescom Can Talk About Is Dolly Parton
news.summary: This year's Gamescom Opening Night Live ceremony just came to an end, and the livestreamed showcase had no sho

content.v: This year's Gamescom Opening Night Live ceremony just came to an end, and the livestreamed showcase had no shortage of highly anticipated announcements and trailers. From a closer look at the upcoming Witcher 3 DLC and the announcement of two PUBG spin-offs, to new glimpses of Control: Resonant , Silent Hill: Townfall , and Final Fantasy 7 Revelation , ONL seemed to have something for everyone. There was even a live performance of a track from the Mewgenics soundtrack.

But between demands for a new Path of Exile 2 trailer (which finally materialized 90 minutes into the showcase) and random declarations of "GTA 6!!!," one message kept popping up in the showcase's live Twitch chat: #RIPDOLLY.
Just moments into the live broadcast, country singer and pop culture icon Dolly Parton's death was announced via an Instagram post shared by her nephew and head of security, Bryan Seaver.

Parton passed away at 80, after decades of smash country hits and admirable charitable giving. Aside from appearing in several casino games, Parton had very little to do with gaming, her biggest contributions being her 2020 collaboration with Word With Friends and the inclusion of her songs "9 to 5" and "Odd Jobs" in 2009's Pop'n Music for the Nintendo Wii. (Though she did appear in her own pinball machine in 1979 .)

But despite her lack of deep connections to the world of gaming, homages to Parton continued to flood the chat even as Gamescom's opening showcase entered its second hour. And in his announcement of her death, Parton's nephew Bryan Seaver explained things perfectly.

"My family and I have shared a lifetime of beautiful memories with Dolly, but so have you," he said. "She has always been on your television, your record player, your CD and on your phone playlist, becoming an extended part of your family whether you liked it or not. Our family and the team she has entrusted with her legacy will work diligently to ensure her spirit will live with us forever. Dolly was a farmer, just like her daddy; he farmed the soil, [while] she farmed songs and happiness."

Perhaps that's the essence of it. Parton connected with everyone--not just country music lovers or fans of her many films. Like games themselves, Parton was a fond part of many of our childhoods. Her charisma was so strong that her memory managed to steal the show at a gaming showcase held half a world away from her home in Tennessee, where her family says she passed peacefully.
Image credit: Getty Images / Ian Gavan

news.title: Gears of War: E-Day Campaign Hands-On Preview: To Quote Marcus Fenix, “Nice”
news.summary: I’m now not only more fired up to finish Gears of War: E-Day’s prequel story than ever, but I’m also more conf

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/22/gowed-blogroll-1787358129687.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:
[ Editor's Note : Mild spoilers ahead for E-Day’s campaign, so turn back now if you don’t want to know any more…]

I’m a massive fan of Gears of War, as I have been since the very beginning. But I have to be honest: something about Gears of War: E-Day’s campaign reveal at the Xbox Showcase a couple months ago just didn’t quite land right with me. It wasn’t bad, by any stretch of the imagination. But I just wasn’t as fired up as I thought I’d be after seeing the first new Gears of War campaign footage in seven years (OK, six if we’re counting Hivebusters).

When I finally sat down to play E-Day’s campaign, though, it took all of about 30 seconds to turn my tepid feelings into joyful smiles. My one-hour preview, which covered the early parts of Act 2, featured plenty of everything I want from and love about Gears of War: Marcus Fenix, Dominic Santiago, lots of story cutscenes, a sweet mix of old weapons and new ones (including the origin story for a signature Gears firearm known for its sharp teeth), some evolved gameplay mechanics, killer setpieces, new Marcus Fenix one-liners, subtle references to characters we know and love, and did I mention Marcus Fenix saying and doing cool sh*t?

I was so fired up by what I played that when I got hit with the “demo complete” screen it actually hurt. I suppose The Coalition got the reaction it wanted from me, because all I wanted to do was keep going. And I’m now not only more fired up to finish Gears of War: E-Day’s prequel story than ever, but I’m also more confident than ever that, at least based on the small slice I’ve played so far, E-Day has struck the exact right balance of tried-and-true old stuff and compelling new stuff.
Playing Bridge

Act 2 picks up with Marcus and Dom still in their civvies, scavenged Mark-1 Lancers in hand. They’ve arrived with fellow civilian-dressed COG soldiers Carter and Reyes at a makeshift command center with the mayor of Kolona, whom they’ve no doubt rescued in Act 1. COG officer Colonel Trench and the mayor face off about whatever the heck is happening out there – you and I both know darn well what it is, of course – and how best to handle it, leading the angry Colonel to yell at our heroes to get some armor on. And then Awesome Moment #1 happens: Marcus and Dom suit up in their familiar COG garb, flanked by Carter and Reyes in the newly christened Bravo Squad. “Guess we’re back to it,” Marcus says, and he might as well be speaking for players as well. My grin could not have been any wider.

Venturing out into the city of Kolona, we see ash raining from a cloudy sky and remnants of once-proud buildings around us. This moment definitely hearkens back to the “destroyed beauty” aesthetic of Gears 1. We soon find our way to the heart of this chapter of gameplay: a massive suspension bridge that raises and lowers in multiple sections in order to let large ships pass underneath it. All of that was in the Before Times, of course, before actual Hell started erupting from the ground beneath the people of this city. We’re making our way towards Oria Stadium, home of the Kolona Eagles thrashball team, where civilians are being routed to in the event of the citywide disaster. But we’re going to have to fight our way there.
Combat Evolved

This straight-ahead bridge section certainly isn’t the combat bowls we’re used to with Gears, but it’s a great way to warm up – not to mention climb up, meaning: to get a feel for using E-Day’s new verticality, i.e. you can now mantle up and over cover, including the cars that the Locust are using to shield themselves. The Mark-1 Lancer, Gnasher shotgun, Snub pistol, and frag grenades all work exactly as you remember them. Gears of War’s core combat has aged remarkably well over the past 20 years. However, E-Day introduces a welcome new evolution in the form of unlockable weapon mods. Each firearm has four total mod slots, and mods vary by weapon, of course. Every reloadable weapon, by default, gets the classic damage bonus if you nail a perfect reload; it’s called Full Metal Jacket now. But there’s a heck of a lot more than just that. For instance, on the aforementioned Gnasher – which, yes, is still your best point-blank bet for turning low-level Locust Drones into chunky-style soup – has an Auto Pouch mod that automatically reloads the shotgun when you stow it (i.e. switch weapons).

This also seems like a good time to mention the new Tactical Gear, which I unlocked at the very end of my demo build. (You got to experience these in the Versus beta weekend, if you participated.) These are short-duration (45-second) buffs with a cooldown, and they also have unlockable mod slots, none of which were available in the preview. But even without mods, the Adrenaline Injector immediately refills your health when triggered and also increases your damage dealt while decreasing damage taken. Choosing the Sonic Disruptor Tactical Gear, meanwhile, nets you a more defensive bonus: stunning low-level enemies in a cone in front of you, interrupting their attacks. With tons more of all of these left to unlock over the course of the campaign, they should add a welcome bit of personalization and gameplay customization to your playthroughs – emphasis on plural there, because I’ll be shocked if there isn’t a New Game+ available that lets you run the campaign again with all of your Tactical Gear and weapon mods available from the jump on higher difficulties.
Revved Up

After battling our way up and across the massive Allfather’s Legacy Bridge, including fending off a couple of Boomers along the way and getting some reps in with the Breechshot (last seen in Gears of War: Judgment), we arrived at Oria Stadium, where the COG was coordinating a stressful civilian rescue operation, with lines of the city’s residents waiting to be processed and allowed into the massive facility. We entered and caught up with the quartermaster, Russ, who took a liking to Marcus because he knew his father, Adam. He asked what Bravo Squad needed, and after Marcus complained about the bayonets easily breaking off of the Mark-1 Lancers, that’s when one of the COG in our party set the chainsaw used to save Marcus’ life in Act 1, as seen in the Xbox Showcase demo, on the table. The quartermaster looks at the chainsaw with a twinkle in his eye, and, yeah…you can probably see where this is going. Awesome Moment #2: Marcus and Bravo Squad get handed the first prototype Mark-2 Lancers with chainsaw built right in. Again, the smile on my face was almost Joker-like.

We headed out from the stadium with the goal of getting across the downtown section of the city to the train station. It’s here that Awesome Moment #3 began to unfold: environmental freedom. The linear path of the bridge we’d fought across had finally given way to a larger combat space. This seems to deliberately rein in Gears 5’s huge open-world areas by instead giving you room to clear Kalona’s streets block-by-block in whatever order and fashion you choose. It’s a smaller-scale version of what we got in the last game, but based on my initial impression, it’s a more effective one. In fact, I ran through the preview build again to take a different route through Kolona, and I’m glad I did. This approach also allows for higher hidden-collectible potential (because yes, of course there are collectibles in a Gears campaign). I also enjoyed the optional secondary objectives in this section that you can opt into. In one, a family was trapped inside a convenience store, and I had to fight off a wave of Wretches before finding a way inside to free them and radio in to get them an escort to the stadium.

news.title: LEGO Skylines Announced at Gamescom
news.summary: A new LEGO city builder known as LEGO Skylines has been announced at Gamescom.

others.title: Leaked Months Ago, Roguelike Strategy Game Worms: Galactic Tactics Finally Announced

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/lego-skylines-game-screenshot-3-1787686623633.webp
A new LEGO city builder known as LEGO Skylines has been announced at Gamescom.

After a leak earlier this summer , Paradox Interactive has officially announced a LEGO version of its beloved city builder series, Cities: Skylines. Developed by Iceflake Studios, LEGO Skylines aims to allow players to build functional and logical cities, as you would in other city builders, but also push them to make something more creative and whimsical. One such example provided by the team behind the game is putting a bakery on every corner of the city, which can produce donuts using wheat provided by farmers from elsewhere in your city.

Using the creativity and imagination of the LEGO brand, LEGO Skylines players will be able to build the city of their dreams — not just maintain a realistic, functioning city, but one that lets them try outlandish and absurd ideas using LEGO bricks and decorations. The game promises a "frankly absurd amount of buildings, decorations, and other cool stuff" to build cities.

“Building and creativity have always been at the heart of the LEGO experience, but LEGO Skylines takes us into completely new territory,” said Fredrik Löving, SVP, Global Head of game at the LEGO Group. “Together with Paradox Interactive and Iceflake Studios, we have brought the LEGO experience to one of the world's most beloved gaming genres. From the beginning, our ambition wasn’t just to make a LEGO city-builder, it was to create a game that is considered among the best in the genre. Whether players dream of building a bustling metropolis, a quirky seaside town, or something nobody has imagined before, LEGO Skylines gives them the creative freedom and depth to make it happen.”

All in all, it sounds like a really charming and fun city builder. There's no release date for LEGO Skylines at the moment, but it will be available on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC when it comes out.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

news.title: Atari is taking another shot at reviving RollerCoaster Tycoon
news.summary: RollerCoaster Tycoon Wonderworks is being developed by Springloaded, makers of the excellent Let's Build a Zoo

content.v: Last we saw RollerCoaster Tycoon it was in pretty rickety shape. More than a decade after RollerCoaster Tycoon 3, the follow-up—RollerCoaster Tycoon World—was released to nearly universally poor reviews. Even worse, in one of the all-time dick moves in gaming industry history, Atari launched it exactly one day before rival sim Planet Coaster was due to release. Wow.
That nakedly desperate move didn't help the situation: people liked Planet Coaster and didn't like RCTW, and the Tycoon series has been silent since 2016.
But here we are another decade later, and Atari is bringing RollerCoaster Tycoon back yet again—though I'm already feeling more hopeful about it.

RollerCoaster Tycoon Wonderworks was announced at Gamescom today, and the new entry in the series is being developed by Springloaded, who made the excellent Let's Build a Zoo and is releasing promising gamedev sim Let's Build a Dungeon later this year. That's a good sign, at least!
There's no date on the books yet, and RollerCoaster Tycoon Wonderworks won't be feature complete when it launches: it's "coming soon" to early access. Here's its page on Steam .

news.title: 1666: Amsterdam's early access is live now but there's still plenty that needs ironing out before I'd pay $30 for it
news.summary: Long road ahead.

content.v: It's been a long development for 1666: Amsterdam and the folks over at Panache Digital Games, but after over a decade of fighting and planning, the game's finally made it to early access.

Announced at Opening Night Live , we got to see 1666: Amsterdam's last trailer before its release. It revealed the main characters Noa Brooklyn (the witch) and Aaron (the man trapped in a cat's body) as they traverse through modern day and 17th century Amsterdam on a journey to hunt down, fight, and kill the demonic Originals who have grown too greedy and powerful for their own good.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MUW63Px7ovwe7ShNwYHnjY.jpg

I played through the first hour of the game—which followed straight on from the demo—a few weeks ago, and while it did show promise I wasn't entirely convinced it was ready for early access . Well, now early access is here. I got a sneak peak and well, not a whole lot has changed.

I'm happy to say I've encountered far fewer bugs. There have been a couple of crashes, but there'll be some patches yet before it's in your hands. My greatest issue, though, remains the same—1666: Amsterdam has a lot of interesting ideas which are woven together poorly.

Its setting and premise are exciting—Noa's character design is impeccable, both her civilian and witch attire are beautiful. Same goes for the old town of Amsterdam, you can tell just how much thought and effort has gone into replicating the streets of one of the most beautiful cities in Europe.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wPWTd5SxjSmSUkVMhFbgNZ.jpg

The idea of learning randomised spells as you progress through the game and explore the map is also cool. It provides a double-edged sword to dying—on one hand, you don't want to lose helpful or powerful spells, but on the other it's exciting to be able to re-roll the dice and have the potential of finding something even better. But my favourite part so far has undoubtedly been using Aaron in his cat form to explore.

Clambering through the streets of Amsterdam as a little black cat isn't just fun, but also surprisingly intuitive. I'm getting proficient at worming my way into restricted houses and scoping them out for points of interest or helpful material. I'm even getting good at using my cat charms to distract guards, or terrifying some into possession and total submission—perhaps too good. But these enlightened moments can seem few and far between when the filler is so mismatched, which certainly isn't helped by its heavy-handed use of AI which has managed to creep its way into more than just the demo.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Gv3R8jzvjkNLcsktya6JJZ.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qzJuEEzdw3jyBExsujpNFZ.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dLzXuqUYKDxmUTnt5kDV2Z.jpg

The fights are repetitive but not in a challenging way. I got through the first boss by button mashing and a couple of well placed evades—it definitely didn't feel like I was fighting an all-powerful demon. The exploration can also fall into the same repetitiveness, as the easiest way to get into places is just by possessing someone as Aaron and then having the poor puppet walk Noa in and around the building with no qualms or queries from any of the inhabitants. I could've sat down for a family dinner, and no one would've blinked an eye at me or my suspicious black cat.

Talking of repetitiveness, the people who inhabit this world also follow a strict wardrobe, with all the 'bad guy' soldiers looking almost identical to one another. It's small, but it does enough to ruin your immersion as an all-powerful witch from 1666 Amsterdam.

All of this, though, isn't to say 1666: Amsterdam is a lost cause—it just really needs some more time. The team has also been very upfront about wanting to make finishing touches and polish it, alongside a community which can help guide their hand. So, if that sounds like something you'd want to be involved with then by all means, get in at the ground floor. But for those who may want a more coherent experience before paying $30, it's probably worth waiting a little bit longer before jumping into Noa's shoes.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd.jpg

news.title: Lego Skylines Is A Genius Idea For A Cities: Skylines Spin-Off
news.summary: Paradox Interactive and Iceflake Studios validated some recent leaks at Gamescom Opening Night Live by announc

content.v: Paradox Interactive and Iceflake Studios validated some recent leaks at Gamescom Opening Night Live by announcing Lego Skylines. As its title suggests, it's a spin-off of the city builder Cities: Skylines where everything is made out of Lego.

A press release for Lego Skylines explains that the game will start on a single plot of land, allowing players to build and customize their house. From there, they can build up to an entire neighborhood and then a giant city. Like Cities: Skylines, you'll have to manage the distribution of electricity, food, and water, and build parks, museums, sports parks, and more to keep your citizens happy.

After the rocky launch of Cities: Skylines 2, Iceflake Studios took over the development of that game from Colossal Order. Iceflake is also the developer working on Lego Skylines, with director Lasse Liljedahl saying in a press release that "most of us at Iceflake grew up building Lego sets" and that he is excited to make a city builder that's a "more personal experience."

Generally, I find the high-level pitch for Lego Skylines to be a great game concept, and I'm definitely excited to see more. Lego tie-in games have been a pretty great run recently with Lego Voyagers, Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight , and Lego Party. Hopefully, Lego Skylines is as good as it sounds and won't have the performance issues on PC that Cities: Skylines 2 had at release.
Lego Skylines does not have a release date, but it is confirmed for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

news.title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons Doesn’t Seem Too Concerned With The “D&D” Part Of Its Title
news.summary: After nearly a year of silence, Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons has reemerged to give sword and sorcery fans a fir

content.v: After nearly a year of silence, Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons has reemerged to give sword and sorcery fans a first look at its third-person gameplay. Warlock's gameplay reveal came during Gamescom Opening Night Live , and featured a lengthy trailer showcasing how the game's spell-slinging combat will work.

Based on its latest trailer, Warlock forgoes sticking to the same formula many D&D-based adventure games tend to use, placing an emphasis on spells and combat rather than roleplay and replicating the tabletop experience. This might not appeal to those seeking a more traditional D&D-like experience--or those who are baffled by main character Katri's seemingly infinite spell slots--but its dark fantasy visuals, snappy spellcasting, and Witcher-esque gameplay certainly look fun.

In addition to a first look at gameplay, the trailer also gave us a bit more information regarding the game's setting. It seems as though Warlock will follow Katri's journey through Ravenloft's Domains of Dread. Darkon, the largest and most powerful of these domains, was seen in the trailer; we can only hope that a Darklord Azalin appearance will follow.

Warlock was announced during the 2025 The Game Awards via a stylish heavy metal trailer that spotlighted the game's main character, Katri. In an interview last year, developer Invoke Studios said players will always play as Katri, but may meet other characters and form alliances with them while adventuring.

Earlier this year, it was announced that Maggie Robertson--best known for her performances as Lady Dimitrescu in Resident Evil: Village and Orin the Red in Baldur's Gate 3--would be joining Warlock as Tasha, a Dungeons & Dragons icon whom fans are likely familiar with. Known also as Iggwilv, Zybilna, and The Witch Queen, Tasha is the creator of a Domain of Delight, Prismeer, and one of the universe's most powerful archfey. In Warlock, Tasha serves as Katri's patron, granting her immense power in exchange for obedience.
This isn't Invoke's first stab at a D&D adventure. The studio, formerly Tuque Studios, was also behind 2021's not exactly well-received D&D: Dark Alliance reboot.
Warlock is slated for a 2027 release.

news.title: Next big D&D game fully revealed with lengthy gameplay trailer
news.summary: Warlock gameplay is bringing me back to the mid-2000s.

content.v: Baldur's Gate 3 is a tough act to follow. Larian has moved on from the D&D license to return to its own Divinity world, and it remains to be seen what kind of CPRG follow-up Wizards of the Coast can muster.

In the meantime, the next big D&D game doesn't try for the BG3 throne: Developer Invoke is instead, to my eyes, channeling the 2000s boom of immersive sim-ish action games like The Darkness, Star Wars: The Force Unleashed, and Infamous.
We got our first look at Warlock gameplay at Gamescom's Opening Night Live showcase today. Check it out above.
It looks fun to me, but there is a staged quality to the gameplay, where our hero consistently deploys just the right warlock power at just the right time.

I'm also left curious to find out how much freeform exploration we'll be doing. Invoke describes Warlock as an open world game, and bits of it do have a Skyrim-ey feel: Strolling into town at the start, hearing locals react to your presence. But events progress smoothly from one beat to the next from there—again, perhaps because it's a trailer that needed to move things along.

I have a feeling the characters and story will make or break this one. We've all seen and played lots of this kind of 'use the right power to traverse the gap' adventure before, and my interest will largely be determined by how invested I am in its world.

The warlock class is fun: In D&D, they receive their powers from a supernatural benefactor. Warlock's protagonist, Kaatri, has made a pact with "an ancient and powerful witch" named Tasha, who we get the impression has her own agenda. Conflict, I presume, will ensue.
Warlock is due out next year, and it's got a Steam page live with more info.

news.title: Crimson Desert is Becoming Crimson Desert Enhanced For Free
news.summary: Pearl Abyss has announced Crimson Desert Enhanced, a new version of the game with additional story, available

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/crimson-desert-enhanced-official-announcement-trailer-gamescom-onl-2026-00-00-46-1787686290346.png
Pearl Abyss has announced Crimson Desert Enhanced , a new version of the game with additional story, available free to all players.

Simply update the game to version 2.00.00 and Crimson Desert Enhanced will be yours, Pearl Abyss has aid. So, to be clear, it is just a fresh patch for the existing game — but one that Pearl Abyss feels is so substantial that it warrants an updated title for the full game.

Crimson Desert Enhanced adds new cutscenes and story moments throughout the main questline, plus voiceover support so you can enjoy the game's narrative in German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and Japanese.

Pearl Abyss previously promised a summer roadmap of content that includes improvements to the core narrative – a recurring criticism of the game at launch. And of course, the Enhanced edition will include all existing updates to the game — and there have been a lot, with new bits and pieces every few weeks.

All of this comes ahead of the game's first paid DLC, due this year, and a Nintendo Switch 2 release, expected in early 2027. Research on multiplayer modes and potential sequels is also underway , following the game's breakout success so far.
Crimson Desert launched back in March 19 and was an instant hit for Pearl Abyss. Less than three months after launch, Crimson Desert crossed the 6 million copies sold mark .
Catch up on all of tonight's announcements in our roundup of everything revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 .
Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

news.title: Metro 2039 Explores The Horror Humans Can Commit In Latest Gameplay Trailer
news.summary: The Metro games have never shied away from shoving players into a bleak post-apocalyptic world, but in Metro 2

content.v: The Metro games have never shied away from shoving players into a bleak post-apocalyptic world, but in Metro 2039, things are looking especially grim. Ahead of its release in 2027, a new gameplay trailer for Metro 2039 was revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live , showing how players will have to deal with a new regime that has risen from the ashes of the nuclear war that turned the world into a radioactive wasteland.

The gameplay showcased several hallmarks of the Metro's distinct action. These include dangerous metro tunnels filled with soldiers, monsters inhabiting the radiation-filled surface, and the many, many guns you'll have to dispatch them with. Like previous entries, you'll be able to craft weapons to suit your playstyle, with the gameplay showcasing an aggressive approach to the series' stealth action.

While Metro 2039 still features mutated monsters and ghouls, it seems 4A Games is focusing more on the atrocities humans can commit in this sequel. As described by developers on stage at Opening Night Live, Metro 2039 is about consequences: the cost of silence, the horror of tyranny, the price of freedom. It is clear the studio is drawing from its experience of developing the sequel while enduring the ongoing war in Ukraine.

Metro 2039 features a new protagonist , known as the Stranger . A new power has risen in the form of the Spartan Order, which has evolved from a force for good in the older Metro games into a twisted, authoritarian movement known as the Novareich. Led by Hunter--the very same Spartan Ranger from Metro 2033--the Stranger comes out of exile and embarks on a journey through the remains of Moscow to take down the Novareich and Hunter, its Führer.

Developer 4A Games says that Metro 2039 will be a shocking entry in the series: one where players will have to master exploration, survival, combat, and stealth skills to stand a chance at seeing the Stranger's mission through to the end. Despite being a sequel to the original trilogy, 4A Games says this will be an ideal point to jump in if you haven't yet, too. Metro 2039 launches for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S in February 2027.

news.title: Battle royale goes grunge: there's a new PUBG game and it's set in the '90s
news.summary: PUBG: Ded.net is "a new multiplayer FPS that combines shooter gameplay with roguelite progression across runs.

content.v: No one is safe from '90s nostalgia, not even battle royale. A new PUBG game was announced today at Gamescom, and it's gone grunge, according to publisher Krafton.

Maybe more interestingly, PUBG: Ded.net is also a roguelite, with progression across runs. Take a peek at the announcement trailer below, set to Ministry's "Jesus Built My Hotrod" (though that's industrial, not grunge) and then come back for some more details.

"PUBG: DED.NET is a new multiplayer FPS that combines shooter gameplay with roguelite progression across runs, giving players new ways to experiment, adapt and build their own approach in the strange and unpredictable world of 1990’s Cascadia," says publisher Krafton.

Does that mean its a blend of battle royale and extraction? It sort of sounds that way: "A match lost is never a run wasted. Every drop of blood writes the next chapter—what you scavenge in the world changes you, and that changes how you fight," Krafton says.

"Mix and match dozens of abilities to build your own custom approach to combat. Use car doors as riot shields, cannibalize enemies for health, play dead, or hack payphones to steal money from rivals."
As you might expect, the Steam page also has an AI disclosure, though it's vague: "Our team uses AI tools to help develop some in-game content."
Closed beta test registration is now open if you want to be one of the first players to dive in.

news.title: NBA 2K27 Teases GTA 6 Crossover Of Some Kind
news.summary: 2K Sports has released a new trailer for NBA 2K27 today, and it features a reference to GTA 6 that is promptin

content.v: 2K Sports has released a new trailer for NBA 2K27 today, and it features a reference to GTA 6 that is prompting people to theorize about what it may mean. The Season 1 trailer for NBA 2K27 does a lot more than just show off what's coming in Season 1--it also hints at Seasons 2 and 3.

As you can see in the trailer below, the imagery and styling for Season 3 is plainly referencing GTA 6 with its palm trees, font, and colors. Police sirens can be heard as well, which is another nod to GTA.
The video doesn't specifically state when NBA 2K27's Season 3 will begin. However, it does confirm that Season 2 starts October 16.
If seasons are as long as they have historically be in the past, that would mean Season 3 could start around the end of November. And that lines up nicely with GTA 6's release on November 19.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-25-at-2.26.27-PM-1.png?w=636

This isn't the first time that GTA 6 and basketball have been connected. One of the GTA 6 gameplay leaks showed main character Jason dribbling a basketball and shooting hoops at his house, with many taking this to mean basketball will be a minigame of sorts in GTA 6.
That seems like a safe bet, as does GTA 6 crossing over with NBA 2K27 in some capacity. Take-Two, which owns Rockstar and 2K, might see a rising tide lifting all ships, after all.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-25-at-2.31.59-PM.png?w=636
NBA 2K27 launches into early access on August 26 for people who preordered the game's premium editions. It unlocks for everyone on September 4.

news.title: 店铺经营与动作冒险相结合：《Acornia: Mirror Worlds》正式公布
news.summary: 发行商 The Arcade Crew（Drop Duchy、Abyssus）与开发商 Splashteam（Tinykin、Splasher）今日正式公布 Acornia: Mirror Worlds。这是一款横跨两个

content.v: 发行商 The Arcade Crew（Drop Duchy、Abyssus）与开发商 Splashteam（Tinykin、Splasher）今日正式公布 Acornia: Mirror Worlds。这是一款横跨两个维度、融合动作冒险与店铺经营玩法的游戏，主角是一只年轻的小松鼠，她肩负着两个目标：保护自己的家园，以及烘焙出松鼠界最美味的糕点。Acornia: Mirror Worlds 将于明年登陆 PC、PlayStation 5、Xbox Series X|S 和 Nintendo Switch 2：
https://image.gcores.com/9e4d2efad36253ede5d5c429c676d65c-1920-1080.jpg
在Acornia: Mirror Worlds中，你将化身为松鼠Alva。她生活在一座建于树上的村庄里，并经营着一家甜品店。离开家乡许久后，Alva再次归来，却发现Duramen维度的影响已经腐化了村庄，迫使许多居民离开。Alva必须继续经营自己的店铺，赚钱重建村庄，同时深入Duramen维度的黑暗地下城展开战斗，击败栖息其中的愤怒灵体，净化侵蚀村庄的腐化力量。
https://image.gcores.com/ad3cf7e9a187d001372bbfaeef308397-800-366.gif
幸运的是，Alva制作的美味糕点正是对付Duramen维度黑暗灵体的绝佳武器。随着Alva不断发展自己的甜品店，并通过一道道全新美味的食谱提升店铺声誉，她会先把双颊塞得满满的，再深入地下城，把蛋糕、酥点以及其他美味甜食直接喷向敌人。
https://image.gcores.com/9a9680459228000cb51844b7ed53c410-1920-1080.jpg
不过，这些令人垂涎的“武器”都需要时间制作。帮助Alva扩大店铺、迎接新的顾客，甚至雇用员工来分担工作。除此之外，她还要通过种植和农耕亲手培育并收获各种食材（毕竟所有东西都是自家制作），光靠Alva一个人可忙不过来。员工能够代替你完成各种工作，让甜品店的经营实现自动化。
https://image.gcores.com/b6ee96a1875271bececadd2048112dcf-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/824643dadaf8b2d11847c825f7690a91-1920-1080.jpg
用来攻击的糕点吃光了？没关系，直接把敌人吞下去，再拿它们对付下一个对手。Alva可是一位精明的生意人。
https://image.gcores.com/2df74b04060363d3a1e67b33ad8fddf8-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/a68fb0c14eb135548aa7662cecff70b6-1920-1080.jpg
随着Acornia: Mirror Worlds的故事不断推进，你还需要帮助邻居，并参加各种季节性活动。完成的任务越多，你就会变得越强，而你制作的甜点也会收获越来越多的好评。

news.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Commodore Computer Premieres at Gamescom, and It's Up for Preorder Now
news.summary: The retro-futurism of Cyberpunk 2077 meets the retro computerism of the modern Commodore 64.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/commodore-77-01-1787668050455.png

When I reviewed the Commodore 64 Ultimate, I honestly couldn't believe just how perfect it was. It surprised me in ways I didn't expect, and it's truly the result of a love and respect for the brand. It's why I gave the C64 Ultimate a 10 in my review . It's a thing of beauty, and now Commodore has officially unveiled a gorgeous new update in collaboration with CD Projekt Red: The Commodore 77.

The case itself is gorgeous, with the plate on the function keys now made of brushed metal. That's not a "brushed metal" finish, by the way: it's actually brushed metal. The rest of the case has been colored to match the Cyberpunk style, the Commodore 64 badge has been replaced with a Commodore 77 badge, and there are other changes that have to be seen to really be appreciated. The entire case has a weathered, suitably cyberpunk look to it, but just like with humans, it's what's inside that counts.

Aside from the new look, the Commodore 77 can now run at a blistering 77Mhz, compared to the 1Mhz of the original Commodore 64. There's also 77MB of system RAM compared to the original Ultimate's 16MB. While this new speed and power is pretty impressive (for the 1980s), it does run the risk of making some of your hand-written programs run impossibly fast, but you can toggle the higher speed off and on in the menus.

Hey, speaking of menus, the C77 also has a "custom Cyberpunk 2077 themed Commodore 77 BASIC 2.0 boot screen", which continues the overall Cyberpunk feel. The famous spiral-bound manual that's shipped with each Commodore 64 has also gotten a Cyberpunk facelift, and comes "packed with lore and exclusive Cyberpunk 2077-themed type-in BASIC programs." It's exactly the kind of thing old heads like me crave.

Each Commodore 77 ships with a shard-inspired Arasaka cartridge containing a demo created by Polish demo group Arise, with the soundtrack composed by chiptune artist LukHash. This is an old-school computer demo, the sort of thing hackers used to distribute to show off their chops. I've seen it. It's incredible. It's hard to believe what people can do with such limited computational power, but the soundtrack benefits enormously from the 24-track stereo SID chip that's part of the Ultimate.

Given how well Commodore did with its modern debut, I have no doubt in my mind the C77 is going to be similarly awesome, especially given the pedigree of its collaboration. Did I mention it comes with stickers and pins and in "collectible themed packaging?"
Oh, and it has LED lights that dance to the music on the demo. It's kind of everything I didn't even know I wanted.
Preorders are live at Commodore's website for $377, with an expected release date sometime next year. I, for one, welcome our CyberPunk and Commodore retro future.
Seth Macy is Senior Social Commerce Producer, and just wants to be your friend. You can find him on social media sites @SethFromMaine.

content.v: Today, during Gamescom Opening Night Live , Netease showed off new gameplay for Ananta, its upcoming open-world anime action-adventure. The trailer featured multiple cityscapes, a January 15 release date, and...internet memes?

Indeed, the gameplay was highlighted by multiple references to internet jokes and slang, including the Gatsby lifting glass meme, the Dragon Ball Z "Yamcha death" meme, and the main hero being called the "yeetmaster."

Outside of the jokes, the three-minute trailer showed both Nova City and Lingyun City, the two open area that will make up Ananta's setting. We see traversal via flying car, motorbike, skateboard, and more as the "yeetmaster" meets multiple characters and get into some close calls while traveling through both cities.

Ananta will see players take the role of a single influncer with the goal of saving the world by "going viral." The influencer will meet over 100 characters throughout the quest, each with their own individual questlines, and some can be recruited as allies along the way.

content.v: One of the surprise announcements at Gamescom's Opening Night Live event was PUBG Ded Net, a spin-off with a new premise where "death is only the beginning."
Set in the fictional world of Cascadia in the '90s, Ded Net is a new multiplayer FPS that "combines shooter gameplay with roguelite progression."
That's all there is to go on at this stage, but you can sign up to test the game on Ded Net's website .

It's not surprising to see PUBG expand like this. After all, developer Krafton has said it wants PUBG to become a universe of sorts that spans multiple titles and genres beyond the main battle royale game.

Some of the efforts so far have not worked, as Call of Duty veteran Glen Schofield's horror game The Callisto Protocol was originally envisioned as a PUBG game before dropping its connection to the franchise .
Another spinoff, PUBG Blindspot, shut down after two months .

news.title: Exodus is out early next year, and I think I'm finally on board with the general Mass Effect vibes of it all
news.summary: You'll meet Salt and the gang in April 2027.

content.v: Exodus is not beating the "boy, that sure looks like Mass Effect" charges, but the more I see of it, the more I mean that as a term of endearment. Archetype Entertainment shared another peek at its sci-fi RPG during this year's Opening Night Live showcase, along with its April 7, 2027 release date.

The latest trailer offered a better introduction to Salt, one of Jun Aslan's otherworldly companions. I'm sensing more of that BioWare companion magic with her reveal, and assuming she's the part of the crew I'll lovingly refer to as my child, à la Grunt.

Salt is an Awakened, humanity's self-aware animal neighbors with their own organized societies, hailing from an ocean planet inhabited by an intelligent race of octopuses. She's also a cutie patootie, sassy, and (seemingly) tragic. At the end of the trailer, my new octopus daughter is left sifting through what looks like dried-up ocean life.
Hell no, that's not happening under my watch as Jun. Well, at least I hope it's not.

While she's the star of the show, Salt isn't the only Exodus companion we see more of in the trailer. There's also new footage of Emrys, another of Jun's alien companions, but this one isn't an Awakened. Emrys is a member of a Celestial species "defined by many consciousness," the Deva. I reckon I don't have to keep doing the "like xyz" from Mass Effect, but if you know, you know.

As much as I like what I see from Salt and the gang, I was already warming up to Exodus after flipping through a few recent YouTube uploads from Archetype. The studio's latest preview was another track, Elegy for a Forgotten World , from the RPG's score. It's a chorus of ethereal chanting and otherworldly synth tied together by an appropriately dramatic orchestra. All the usual ingredients you need for sci-fi adventures.
Exodus is available to wishlist on Steam now ahead of its launch early next year on April 7.

news.title: Wait, Is Mega Man: Dual Override Just Mega Man X Now?
news.summary: Mega Man: Dual Override is delivering another retro-inspired take on the classic Blue Bomber with a release sl

content.v: Mega Man: Dual Override is delivering another retro-inspired take on the classic Blue Bomber with a release slated next year. But based on his latest trailer revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live , he's cribbing heavily from his sequel series, Mega Man X.

The trailer showed Mega Man using special equipment allowing him to dash, hover, and more. Those moves are familiar for fans of the MMX series, which takes place a hundred years after the original Mega Man. The dashing especially has always set Mega Man X apart, making it a much faster action game. But it appears this new Mega Man title will bring some of that back as well. Mega Man even has some stylized glowy bits on his armor to signify the changes, though it looks more like his robotic paneling is opening up.

It's not clear from the trailer how limited these moves will be, and it's possible they'll be saved for special situations rather than serving as permanent armor upgrades like in the Mega Man X series. And we also saw some other powers that aren't part of the X series, like a rapid-charged fire that absolutely filled the screen with blasts, immediately taking down hapless robot goons.

The trailer also teased a new Robot Master for the series, Twinkle Girl. This will be just the second female robot master, after Mega Man 9's Splash Woman. We haven't yet seen the winner of the design a robot master contest . And just after the announcement, it teased Mega Man and Roll skins coming for Hugh and Diana in Pragmata--which was rumored, before release, to be a stealth Mega Man reboot.

news.title: The next game from Hoyoverse sure looks like someone put Elden Ring's clothes on Monster Hunter
news.summary: Who among us doesn't love to sever the Dreadnodus?

content.v: As the opening reveal of this year's Gamescom Opening Night Live, HoYoverse brought its first official look at Nodusfall—a change of pace for the gacha game behemoth that looks a little bit Elden Ring, a lot bit Monster Hunter, and a whole pile of proper nouns added for good measure.

While I like to think it takes more to catch my attention than forcefully mashing together two things I think are neat, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't tempted by the idea. If there's one thing Monster Hunter monsters have been missing, it's FromSoft-style primordial depression.

From the looks of things, there's more than enough metaphysical malaise to go around in Nodusfall. The laws of divinity have apparently frayed, plunging creation into a state of cosmic disarray. There are 10 suns now. Ideally, there's only supposed to be one of those. Not great!

Luckily for those of us who like to be given an excuse to try to fight a lizard 30 times our size, all that profound devastation seems to have produced a wide selection of giant, charismatic creatures to swordfight alongside your friends. In the reveal trailer embedded above, I saw giant bears, some sort of giant pack foxes, a horned, winged manticore, and a dragon or two (giant). I don't yet know how Nodusfall's progression works, but if I'm not allowed to harvest all their individual pieces and turn them into pants, I'm going to feel personally betrayed.

While the glimpses of combat shown in the footage looks like it hews pretty closely to the pace and rhythm of Monster Hunter, Nodusfall does seem to be dropping a few original elements into the mix. At one point, one of the player characters uses some sort of transformation ability to become a giant, armored knight in the middle of a hunt. And later, two players perform an elaborate, paired execution animation.

What remains to be seen is what sort of monetization scheme Nodusfall will be wrapped in—something that HoYoverse's history doesn't exactly inspire confidence about. If I have to do gacha pulls for a gunlance, I'm going to have a hard time.
Nodusfall doesn't have much of an online presence yet, so it'll likely be a while before we can expect a release date.

news.title: Exodus Release Date Revealed, the Mass Effect-Like RPG Is Coming in April
news.summary: Exodus shares plenty of similarities with Mass Effect and seems to be filling the sci-fi RPG void; you won't h

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/04-4k-exodus-salt-trailer-2-1787649566543.jpg

During gamescom's Opening Night Live , developer Archetype Entertainment revealed the release date for its Mass Effect-like spacefaring RPG: Exodus is launching on April 7, 2027 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store. It premiered a new cinematic trailer that showcased new characters and gameplay centered around an intelligent octopus who pilots a mech suit.

Her name is Salt and she is one of several party members you'll gather in Exodus. She is an Awakened, which in the universe of Exodus are hyper-intelligent animals and wildlife who can communicate with humans. Salt will be a long-range sniper who can use an ink smokescreen to provide cover in combat. The trailer hits heavier beats that tease some of its story elements – while Salt gives the main character Jun hard time and tends to be confrontational, she's emotionally driven to protect her species and homeworld.

One of the major hooks of Exodus is the scientific incorporation of time dilation and how it'll affect the story. In true RPG fashion, it'll have player choices that can change outcomes and you'll have a crew to accompany you (a Traveler known as Jun) along the interstallar journey where humanity had to flee Earth and find a new home in the great expanse.

Veteran narrative designer and writer Drew Karpyshyn is the narrative director on Exodus. If you're not familiar, he worked on some of BioWare's most critically acclaimed games serving as senior writer on Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic and lead writer on Mass Effect.

Exodus was first revealed during The Game Awards 2023 and made headlines for having famed actor Matthew McCounghey voicing the trailer and playing a character in the game. There was an extended 20-minute gameplay reveal back in June that showcased the action RPG combat, which is very reminescent of Mass Effect with its shooting mechanics and commanding of party member abilities – it also shares a particular sci-fi aesthetic with the BioWare series. Archtype Entertainment has been working under Wizards of the Coast since 2020 and it won't be long until we can finally play what its been working on.

news.title: Every Magic: The Gathering Set Confirmed for 2027 (So Far!)
news.summary: Wizards of the Coast is scaling back to six Magic: The Gathering sets in 2027. Here is the full schedule, incl

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mtg-2027-release-schedule-1787582249118.png
So much has been made of Universes Beyond, Magic: The Gathering’s crossovers with other IP, that many have dubbed the game “the Fortnite of card games”.

2026 saw seven sets in a single calendar year, which means that—at the time of writing—we’re transitioning from Marvel Super Heroes to The Hobbit. 2027, however, will be different: Not only is Wizards of the Coast cutting the number of sets down to six (with three Universes Within and three Universes Beyond), but we won’t get a double-helping of Universes Beyond at all - hooray!
Here’s all we know about Magic’s 2027 sets so far, and what to expect from them.
Nauctis: The Sunken Realm
February 5, 2027

The first set of 2027 will debut in early February, and it’ll take us to Nauctis. This “Sunken Realm” is all about being under the waves, so you can expect some deep-sea humans alongside merfolk, homarids, and seals.

Here’s Wizards of the Coast’s synopsis: “As tensions bubble between two warring kingdoms, a group of unlikely heroes must rise to the occasion—or their home will be swallowed up by the abyssal depths of the ocean. Adventures await under the water, and players will come face to face with fearsome creatures that dwell far, far from the surface.”
Kamigawa: Titanbreach
June 4, 2027
2026 saw two trips back to iconic planes with Lorwyn and Strixhaven, and in 2027 we’re heading back to Kamigawa.
The cyberpunk-infused setting will see a huge shift when the Ikoria plane crashes into it, leading to a mechs versus kaiju set.

“Return to Kamigawa and harness the power of next-generation mechs that can match the might of any titan. The Kamigawans will need all the help they can get, because the behemoths of Ikoria may be the greatest threat this plane has ever seen.”

“And if you'd rather be the monster than fight them, you can harness your favorite creatures from Ikoria in the battle for the city. Suit up, get ready to rumble, and witness a battle on a scale you've never seen before.”
Zhalfir
October 1, 2027
Zhalfir sounds a lot like it’ll be a love letter to longtime Magic fans, arriving as its own plane and bringing back the legendary chronomancer, Teferi Akosa.
It’ll lean into the afrofantasy subgenre, but we don’t know much else about it just yet.

“Immerse yourself in the beauty of Zhalfir and harness innovative new forms of magic. The minds behind this plane have crafted some especially mind-bending cards, each embracing the unique visual design of Magic's take on the afrofantasy genre.”

“And because Zhalfir is so closely tied to an era of Magic that many players hold dear, we're honoring its legacy in every aspect of the set. This is Magic: The Gathering as you remember it, crafted with the love and care of our contemporary design philosophy.”
Universes Beyond
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mtg-universes-beyond-20276-predictions-2-1787570796222.png
We are yet to have anything confirmed for 2027 Universes Beyond, but that won't stop us speculating on what could be in store. For now, we have the dates in which we should expect the three sets.

Beyond that, if you'll pardon the pun, the only piece of info we have is from Hasbro CEO Chris Cocks notes in the recent earnings report . Cocks noted feedback on recent Universes Beyond sets, which have run the gamut from two trips to Middle-Earth, just as many visits to New York City, every single Final Fantasy, and, soon, Star Trek.
“The one thing I'll say on the Universes Beyond partners that we have next year is they'll probably be a bit more fantasy-adjacent," he explained.
"And I don't think any of them will take place in New York City because we definitely have gotten that feedback from some fans."
From that, there are a lot of potential crossovers that would be fun for Magic: The Gathering, but the idea of refocusing on fantasy IP certainly is interesting.

We've recently predicted it could be anything from Games of Thrones, to Elden Ring, Warhammer: Age of Sigmar, The Legend of Zelda, The Witcher, and something else Marvel related. But, that's purely speculation, and we shall have to wait and see what is officially announced later this year.

Lloyd Coombes is an experienced freelancer in tech, gaming and fitness seen at Polygon, Eurogamer, Macworld, TechRadar and many more. He's a big fan of Magic: The Gathering and other collectible card games, much to his wife's dismay.

与龙神伙伴并肩，在腐化世界中杀出一条血路。这款肾上腺素飙升的动作平台游戏融合了自由战斗、流畅的平台跳跃与科幻探索。成为失落之神Elta的勇者。

news.title: I attempted to become a professional driver in a GTA 5 where every car had no friction
news.summary: Gotta make ends meet somehow.

content.v: If you remember, uh, yesterday, then you'll remember how I have recently modded GTA 5 to essentially deactivate friction on all NPC cars. Also, all NPC cars are perpetually, unstoppably in motion. Long story short: they keep accidentally flying and/or exploding.
So I thought what I could do today would be to try to become a professional driver in that world.

I have installed The Getaway (Driver Missions) , a mod which lets you dial a new number in your phone in order to undertake road quests . In practice, that means driving to a place, picking a guy up, then driving that guy to another place. At some point in this process you lose the cops.

All well and good, but not overly dramatic. What makes it a lot more hair-raising is every other driver on Los Santos' roads no longer obeys the laws of physics. Even driverless cars are irrepressibly compelled forwards, making it damn-near impossible to actually acquire a car to undertake these missions.

Fortunately, I am a lateral thinker. I simply used my car gun to summon a car directly into a wall. As the unstoppable force met the immoveable object, I was able to get in and go about my business. Sort of. When every car in the game is incapable of stopping but perfectly capable of murder, every single intersection in Los Santos becomes a dance with death.

Even picking up my fare was dicey—as he attempted to get into my car (which was, for whatever reason, an inexplicably snow-covered North Yankton police truck), a taxi cab floated nearby like a leaf on the wind, pancaking a separate pedestrian mere inches from my passenger.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gJGyyHdzZG8q7a8jDuvLGE.gif
I guess what I'm saying is: walkable urban spaces now.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA.jpg
